name: beeper-synch
description: Mac-only supervisor for the existing Beeper sync pipeline: spawns packages/beeper-ws (long-lived, backoff-restarted), schedules packages/beeper-sync (periodic incremental REST sync, serialized) and refreshes the local Mongo readonly mirror (dba's refreshBeeperMongoMirror), all as one process with a single-instance lock and graceful shutdown. No Beeper/Mongo sync logic of its own — see README.md.

scripts.test: tsx src/config.test.ts && tsx src/lock.test.ts && tsx src/backoff.test.ts && tsx src/mirror-scheduler.test.ts
